results_section.claim: 3. scVI achieved the highest aggregate integration score (0.74 vs. 0.72 for ComBat; Fig. 2M)

The paper claims 0.74 for scVI (close, likely rounded up from 0.734) and 0.72 for ComBat, but the repository shows ComBat scored 0.651, not 0.72. results_section.explanation: Execution stage: The paper claims Pancreas shows only moderate correlation to gut tissues (r≈0.49-0.53), but the computed Pearson correlations between Pancreas and all gut tissue rows are 0.109–0.251, far below the claimed range.
